title: Optimize token entropy and visual weight system for responsive data cards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Our current token set yields inconsistent perceived weight across responsive data cards (dashboard widgets, KPI tiles, list-rows). Small cards feel visually heavy due to high-contrast accents and shadow scale, while large cards can appear washed out. This causes layout noise in analytics pages and forces per-component overrides. Goal: Introduce a compact, density-aware visual-weight axis and formalize entropy constraints for color, type, spacing, radius, and elevation tokens so that cards scale predictably across breakpoints without ad-hoc overrides. Scope: design tokens only (color ramps, type scale deltas for card contexts, spacing/radius presets for compact/regular/expanded, shadow presets tuned for card size). Deliverables: updated token spec, Figma component kit, migration guide, tokens migration PR, QA checklist and visual regression baseline for analytics dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Add visual-weight token axis (v.weight-0..v.weight-5) mapped to color saturation, type weight delta, and elevation presets in core tokens
Create density presets for cards: card-density-compact, card-density-regular, card-density-expanded with explicit spacing/radius/elevation values
Figma components updated and annotated; prototype toggles density and shows consistent perceived weight
All affected components pass automated color-contrast checks (WCAG AA where text smaller than 18px requires 4.5:1 for primary text) and visual diff threshold < 2% for approved pages
Migration guide with code snippets and codemod patterns published to Confluence and linked from SDK docs
Design sign-off from PM and Eng (UX: Priya Rao, Eng: Daniel Kim) and a targeted runtime-compatibility review from the infra team
tasks: Define visual-weight axis mapping: document mathematical mapping between weight step and saturation/alpha/elevation
Audit existing card usages across console (dashboards, alerts, collections) and list override patterns
Produce Figma component kit updates and create density toggle variants
Author token spec PR and JSON export for platform ingestion
Write migration guide + codemod (examples for React components using tokens)
Coordinate with ENG for rollout flags and runtime feature gating
Create visual regression storybook stories and baseline snapshots
decisions: Use perceptual saturation scale (HSL with contrast-compensated L adjustments) rather than fixed hex steps to reduce entropy across breakpoints
Bind visual-weight token to three channels: hue/saturation (color), font-weight delta (typography), and elevation intensity (shadow blur & offset) for holistic perception control
Keep neutral surface colors untouched for majority of system; introduce v.weight tokens primarily for accenting and card surfaces to avoid regressions in forms and tables
Introduce three density presets (compact/regular/expanded) not continuous interpolation to simplify implementation and testing
Fallback policy: if runtime environment does not support new tokens, map v.weight-X to existing semantic accent/neutral tokens (documented in migration guide)
